project: Wuxia Life P79 Renown Late-Life Playable Implementation
description: Implement the renown late-life stage (晚景几何) for jianghu_renown_sage tavern_hand seed — runtime auto event wiring with 3 branches, expression updates for all 3 branches, targeted proof, and regression tests. Strictly follows P78 late-life contract.

userStories.title: Wire renown late-life spine event
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the renown late-life event wired through the existing event system so players on the renown route encounter a real late-life milestone with 3 distinct branches.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure renown_late_life auto event in sample-lines-spine.json
Trigger conditions: renown_midlife_payoff_done + age 52-56 + exclusivity guard + no orthodox/demonic
Set renown_late_life_done checkpoint flag + renown_late_life_identity_done
Set branch-specific markers: tavern_renown_late_burnout / tavern_renown_late_lone_wolf / tavern_renown_late_mentor
Branching logic: based on payoff choice marker (hard_holder→burnout, breaker→lone_wolf, balancer→mentor)
Correct stat changes per branch: A(rep+2,con+1,cha-1) / B(rep-1,con-2,cha+3) / C(rep+3,con+2,cha+2)
No new event framework or scheduler
P71/P72/P73/P75/P77 existing evidence does not regress
userStories.notes: 3 auto events wired (burnout/lone_wolf/mentor), age 52-56, payoff marker branching, exclusivity guard, stats per branch

userStories.title: Add late-life player-facing expression — sample line core (P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want the renown late-life stage reflected in my sample line status so the route feels like it has a meaningful late-life identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Sample line cost label: payoff state → late-life state (油尽灯枯 / 逍遥自在 / 传承授业)
Sample line current goal: payoff state → late-life state (撑到最后 / 过好剩下的日子 / 指点后辈)
At least 2 late-life-specific readable signals (cost label + current goal)
Three branches have meaningfully different expressions, not reskinned
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor
No new UI components
userStories.notes: Sample line cost label + current goal updated for all 3 branches; tavern-born flavor preserved

userStories.title: Add late-life player-facing expression — late-life identity (P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want a late-life identity summary that deepens my age-40 identity so the late-life stage feels like it defines who I become.
acceptanceCriteria: renownAge40Identity() expanded to check renown_late_life_identity_done first, then fall back to renown_age40_identity_done
Branch A: 油尽灯枯的老好人
Branch B: 逍遥自在的孤翁
Branch C: 德高望重的老前辈
Three branches have meaningfully different identity descriptions
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor
userStories.notes: renownAge40Identity() checks late-life identity first; 3 distinct identities: 油尽灯枯的老好人/逍遥自在的孤翁/德高望重的老前辈

userStories.title: Add late-life player-facing expression — ordinary origin (bonus P1)
userStories.description: As a player, I want additional late-life-specific expressions in the ordinary origin view so the late-life stage feels richer and more memorable.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary origin current goal: late-life state update (consistent with sample line)
Ordinary origin life memory: late-life-specific text (different per branch)
Ordinary origin summary: late-life state update (different per branch)
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor
No new UI components
userStories.notes: Ordinary origin current goal + life memory + summary updated for all 3 branches; tavern-born flavor preserved

userStories.title: Add targeted late-life proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the renown late-life event fires correctly, all three branches work, and tavern-born renown flavor is preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce 1 targeted proof (payoff → late-life → expression changes path verification)

Show 8 core nodes: pre-late-life baseline → event fires → Branch A flags+stats → Branch B flags+stats → Branch C flags+stats → cost label per branch → current goal per branch → late-life identity per branch
Optional bonus nodes: life memory, origin summary, full chain traceback, mutex with other lines, branch matching, tavern-born flavor check
No full lifetime exhaust required
Proof supports whether to continue endgame stage decision
Save as docs/test-reports/p79-renown-late-life-targeted-proof.md
userStories.notes: 8 core + 5 bonus chain nodes verified; saved to docs/test-reports/p79-renown-late-life-targeted-proof.md

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the renown late-life stage so future edits do not break the first renown late-life milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: New test file covering late-life stage
Group 1: Event wiring (4 tests) — existence, auto type, age range, conditions
Group 2: Pre-late-life state (2 tests) — state verification after payoff before late-life
Group 3: Branch A post-late-life (4 tests) — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 4: Branch B post-late-life (4 tests) — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 5: Branch C post-late-life (4 tests) — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 6: Distinct from merchant late-life (2 tests)
Group 7: No regression of P71/P72/P73/P75/P77 (5 tests)
Reuse existing test harness
All relevant commands pass
userStories.notes: 9 test groups covering event wiring, 3 branches, no regression; all pass; saved to tests/p79TavernHandRenownLateLifeSpineTests.ts

userStories.title: Produce P79 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what the renown late-life stage now provides and whether endgame stage is justified next.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p79-renown-late-life-closure-report.md
Summarize event wiring, expressions, proof, tests
State whether subsequent endgame / final legacy stage is worth opening
List larger renown-expansion items that remain deferred
All 9 closure criteria satisfied (from P78 validation shape)
userStories.notes: 7/7 stories passed; 9/9 closure criteria satisfied; saved to docs/test-reports/p79-renown-late-life-closure-report.md
